name: List view threshold (SharePoint)
short_description: The SharePoint limit, 5,000 items by default, on how many list items a single database operation such as a view query can process at once; it does not cap how many items a list can store.

evidence.quote: larger view thresholds, too many look ups or data models that demand relationships
The 5,000 item list view threshold isn't a myth. It's the guardrail.
Let me show you exactly how the list view threshold and forces behavior.
The list view threshold of 5,000 isn't negotiable.
Its list view threshold slams at five thousand items.
